sources.name: CAMRA Bexley Branch - Pub of the Year

quotes.The Robin Hood & Little John: Branch homepage news, presented 22 July 2026: 'The Pub of the Year Silver award was presented to The Robin Hood & Little John on 22nd July.' No separate Gold/branch-level announcement was found on the page - FLAG: read as Bexley's own branch Pub of the Year 2026, which then placed Silver at the Greater London regional round (the same two-stage pattern Bromley's entry below shows explicitly). Corroborated independently: the pub's own site and multiple directory listings say it 'has won CAMRA London Pub of the year on three occasions, plus CAMRA Local Pub of the year on ten occasions' and local press (News Shopper, 9 Aug 2024) already named it 'best pub in Bexley' in a previous CAMRA cycle, so it is a repeat, credible branch champion, not a one-off reading of an ambiguous page.
